summary: Clarivate PLC filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 announcing that wholly-owned subsidiary Clarivate Science Holdings Corporation launched a cash tender offer for up to $75,000,000 aggregate principal of its 3.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2028, subject to a Tender Cap with proration. The issuer may eliminate, increase, or decrease the cap before the Expiration Date. Mechanics include pro-rata scaling rounded to $1,000 increments, with an optional 2% upsize without amendment. Watch for participation levels, proration risk, and any cap adjustment signaling refinancing or deleveraging intent.
